$comment: The only file you must edit to adopt this workspace. Everything else reads from here.
codeDirs — the paths that hold PRODUCT CODE, relative to this file. Edits inside them
require a card in board/3-build; edits everywhere else (docs, the workspace itself, the
plan) do not. Get this wrong in the permissive direction and the gate is decoration; get
it wrong in the strict direction and it fires on your own README and gets switched off
Two ways to point at your code, and both work:
1. keep your code in ./code — a real directory, or a symlink to a sibling repo
depthCheckPaths — what `depth-check` scans for stub-shaped code at 4-review and later.
Leave empty to scan everything under codeDirs.
Nothing here is validated at startup on purpose: a config that refuses to load takes the
guards down with it, and a guard that is off is worse than one that is loose, because
